idea-plugin.name: Pacmon
idea-plugin.description:
package.json says what you depend on. Pacmon adds why.

Every dependency gets a short note: why it is here, what must not change, what to check before an upgrade. The note shows in package.json as quick documentation, and you write it from there.

All notes live in one Markdown file, .pacmon/DEPENDENCY-NOTES.md, next to package.json. No database, no service, no account: one file that you read, diff and commit like any other. AI coding agents read the same file before they touch a package, and keep their own lines in it.

  • A mark before each package name in package.json: filled when it has a note, hollow when it does not. The first line of the note shows at the end of the line; the whole note shows as quick documentation.
  • Write a note from package.json in the Pacmon tool window, with a layer for people and a layer for agents.
  • Documentation Coverage lists which dependencies have a note and which do not.
  • Problems in the notes file are underlined as you write, and Format DEPENDENCY-NOTES.md rewrites the file into canonical form.
  • Set Up AI Instructions writes the rules for AI coding agents to .pacmon/AGENT-RULES.md and points AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and similar files to it.

Pacmon reads and writes files in your project and makes no network requests; it does not call any AI service. The VS Code extension reads the same file, and the format is documented in docs/format.md.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.1

The first release of Pacmon for JetBrains IDEs. It reads and writes the same .pacmon/DEPENDENCY-NOTES.md as the VS Code extension.

  • Marks, end-of-line previews and quick documentation for the dependencies in package.json.
  • The Pacmon tool window: documentation coverage, settings, and a note editor with a layer for people and a layer for agents.
  • Live format warnings in DEPENDENCY-NOTES.md, and Format DEPENDENCY-NOTES.md to rewrite it into canonical form.
  • Set Up AI Instructions, Documentation Coverage and Open DEPENDENCY-NOTES.md in the Tools menu.
